title: Fikrni dalil bilan himoya qilish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida fikr, sabab, dalil va misoldan iborat argument qurasiz, hedging va kuchaytirish iboralarini ishlatasiz, qarshi fikrni tan olib rad etasiz hamda ikki daqiqalik asoslangan nutq ayta olasiz.

scenes.title: Fikrni himoya qilish san’ati
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda ish va karyera lug‘atini, rasmiy xat va muloyim muloqotni o‘rgandik. Bugun esa fikringizni tartibli, ishonarli va dalillar bilan himoya qilishni mashq qilamiz. Bu IELTS ning gapirish qismida ham, ish yig‘ilishida ham, kundalik bahslarda ham kerak. Dars oxirida ikki daqiqalik asoslangan nutq tayyorlay olasiz.
scenes.say: Hello again! Today we learn to defend an opinion clearly and convincingly, with reasons and evidence.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom! Bugun fikringizni aniq va ishonarli tarzda, sabab va dalillar bilan himoya qilishni o‘rganamiz.

scenes.title: Dalilli fikrning to‘rt qismi

examples.t: Remote work should be the default.
examples.uz: Masofaviy ish asosiy shakl bo‘lishi kerak.

examples.t: It saves time, for example, the commute.
examples.uz: U vaqtni tejaydi, masalan, yo‘lga ketadigan vaqtni.

scenes.say_native: Ishonarli fikr to‘rt qismdan iborat. Birinchisi claim, ya’ni sizning asosiy fikringiz. Ikkinchisi reason, nega shunday deb o‘ylaysiz. Uchinchisi evidence, ya’ni dalil: fakt, tadqiqot, mutaxassis fikri yoki shaxsiy tajriba. To‘rtinchisi example, aniq misol. Ko‘p o‘quvchilar faqat claim ni ayta oladi, xolos. O‘zbekcha bahsda ham “nega?” degan savol keladi, inglizchada esa tinglovchi bu savolni berishidan oldin siz javob berib qo‘yishingiz kerak.
scenes.say: A strong opinion has four parts: a claim, a reason, evidence, and an example.
scenes.say_uz: Kuchli fikr to‘rt qismdan iborat: da’vo, sabab, dalil va misol.

scenes.title: Namuna: to‘liq dalil
board: Evidence: Air quality improves when traffic falls.
Example: In my city, centre closures helped.
scenes.say_native: Mana to‘liq qurilgan dalil namunasi. Avval fikr, keyin sabab, dalil va misol. E’tibor bering, har bir qism oldingisini qo‘llab-quvvatlaydi va gaplar bog‘lovchilar bilan bir-biriga ulangan. Xuddi shu tartibni o‘zingiz ham qo‘llaysiz.
scenes.say: I believe cities should limit cars. The main reason is pollution. When traffic falls, the air quality usually improves. For instance, in my city, closing the centre to cars made the streets cleaner and quieter.
scenes.say_uz: Menimcha, shaharlar mashinalarni cheklashi kerak. Asosiy sabab havo ifloslanishi. Transport kamayganda havo sifati odatda yaxshilanadi. Masalan, mening shahrimda markazni mashinalarga yopish ko‘chalarni toza va tinch qildi.

scenes.title: Fikringizni aytish iboralari
board: In my view / In my opinion

examples.t: I'd argue that education should be free.
examples.uz: Menimcha, ta’lim bepul bo‘lishi kerak.

examples.t: From my perspective, quality matters more than speed.
examples.uz: Mening nuqtai nazarimdan, sifat tezlikdan muhimroq.

scenes.say_native: Har gapni “I think” bilan boshlash zerikarli eshitiladi. Boshqa variantlar: In my view, In my opinion, From my perspective, To my mind. “I'd argue that” bahsli fikr uchun juda yaxshi, “I firmly believe that” esa kuchliroq. Muhim: bu iboralardan keyin that qo‘yiladi va to‘liq gap keladi. Hamda bitta iborani ikki marta ishlatmang: “In my opinion, I think” takror bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: In my view, quality matters more than speed. I'd argue that education should be free.
scenes.say_uz: Menimcha, sifat tezlikdan muhimroq. Ta’lim bepul bo‘lishi kerak, deb hisoblayman.

scenes.title: Sababsiz fikr
board: ✗ I think it's good because it's good.
✓ I think it's good because it saves time.
✓ In my opinion, ... / To my mind, ...
scenes.say_native: Ikkita xato. Birinchisi: aylanma mantiq, “yaxshi, chunki yaxshi”. Sabab fikrning takrori emas, yangi ma’lumot bo‘lishi kerak. Ikkinchisi: “According to me”. O‘zbekcha “menga ko‘ra” yoki rus tilidagi “по-моему” dan tarjima. Inglizchada according to boshqa odam yoki manbaga nisbatan ishlatiladi: according to the report. O‘zingizning fikringiz uchun in my opinion yoki to my mind deng.
scenes.say: Give a real reason, not the same idea again. And do not say according to me.
scenes.say_uz: Haqiqiy sabab keltiring, bir fikrni takrorlamang. According to me demang.

scenes.title: Qismlarni toping
board: A) Everyone should learn to code.
B) It is a skill that many jobs now require.
C) For instance, even marketers analyse data.
D) Many employers list it in job adverts.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap bor. Har biri qaysi qismga tegishli: claim, reason, evidence yoki example? Birinchi gap kodni hamma o‘rganishi kerak degan fikr. Ikkinchisi, ko‘p ishlarda bu ko‘nikma talab qilinadi. Uchinchisi for instance bilan boshlanadi. To‘rtinchisi ish e’lonlari haqida. Har birini nomlang.
scenes.say: Label each sentence: claim, reason, evidence or example.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapni nomlang: da’vo, sabab, dalil yoki misol.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. A bu claim, asosiy fikr. B reason, sabab: ko‘p ishlarda bu ko‘nikma kerak. D evidence: ish e’lonlarida tez-tez ko‘rsatilishi, bu tekshirsa bo‘ladigan fakt. C example, for instance bilan kirgan aniq misol. Ko‘rdingizmi, example so‘zi yoki iborasi odatda signal beradi.
scenes.say: Everyone should learn to code. Many jobs require it. Many employers list it in job adverts. For instance, even marketers analyse data.
scenes.say_uz: Hamma dasturlashni o‘rganishi kerak. Ko‘p ishlar buni talab qiladi. Ko‘p ish beruvchilar buni e’lonlarda ko‘rsatadi. Masalan, marketologlar ham ma’lumot tahlil qiladi.

scenes.title: Sabab bog‘lovchilari va dalil turlari

examples.t: The shop closed due to rising costs.
examples.uz: Do‘kon xarajatlar oshgani sababli yopildi.

examples.t: According to the report, prices have risen.
examples.uz: Hisobotga ko‘ra, narxlar oshgan.

scenes.say_native: Sabab bildirish uchun because, since, as. Since va as ko‘proq yozma uslubga xos va gap boshida keladi. Due to va because of dan keyin ot yoki ot birikmasi keladi, to‘liq gap emas: due to rising costs. Dalil turlari: aniq fakt, statistika, mutaxassis fikri, shaxsiy tajriba. Manbani ko‘rsatish uchun according to ... ishlatiladi. Eng muhim qoida: statistikani hech qachon o‘ylab topmang, aniq bilmasangiz, “many”, “a growing number of” kabi umumiy shakldan foydalaning.
scenes.say: Since prices rose, many shops closed. According to the report, costs have risen. A growing number of people work from home.
scenes.say_uz: Narxlar oshgani uchun ko‘p do‘konlar yopildi. Hisobotga ko‘ra, xarajatlar oshgan. Uydan ishlaydiganlar soni ortib bormoqda.

scenes.title: Misol keltirish

examples.t: Many countries, such as Japan, have ageing populations.
examples.uz: Ko‘p mamlakatlar, masalan Yaponiya, aholisi qarimoqda.

examples.t: Take my sister, for example. She learned Spanish online.
examples.uz: Singlimni olaylik. U ispan tilini onlayn o‘rgandi.

scenes.say_native: Misol keltirishning bir nechta usuli bor. For example va for instance gap boshida keladi, ularning ortidan vergul. Such as ro‘yxatni gap ichida kiritadi: countries such as Japan. Such as dan keyin etc. qo‘shilmaydi. “A case in point” rasmiyroq: bu fikrga yaxshi misol. “Take ... for example” esa so‘zlashuvga yaqin. Bitta misolni batafsil tushuntirish uchta qisqa misoldan ko‘ra ko‘pincha ishonarliroq.
scenes.say: Many countries, such as Japan, have ageing populations. Take my sister, for example.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘p mamlakatlarda, masalan Yaponiyada, aholi qarimoqda. Misol uchun singlimni olaylik.

scenes.title: Misol xatolari
board: ✗ For example I have a car.
✓ For example, I have a car.
scenes.say_native: Ikkita nozik xato. Birinchisi: for example dan keyin vergulni tushirib qoldirish. Yozma nutqda vergul kerak, og‘zaki nutqda esa qisqa pauza. Ikkinchisi: such as bilan etc. ni birga ishlatish. Such as ro‘yxatning namuna ekanini o‘zi bildiradi, shuning uchun etc. ortiqcha. Yana bitta: “for example” bilan boshlangan gap to‘liq gap bo‘lishi kerak, yarim gap emas.
scenes.say: Put a comma after for example, and do not use etc. after such as.
scenes.say_uz: For example dan keyin vergul qo‘ying va such as dan keyin etc. ishlatmang.

scenes.title: Dalil quring
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz dalil quring. Fikr: o‘quvchilar forma kiyishi kerak. Unga sabab, dalil va misol qo‘shing. Because va for instance iboralaridan foydalaning. Masalan, tenglik, e’tiborni jamlash yoki xarajat haqida o‘ylashingiz mumkin. O‘n besh soniya vaqtingiz bor.
scenes.say: Claim: students should wear uniforms. Add a reason, some evidence and an example.
scenes.say_uz: Fikr: o‘quvchilar forma kiyishi kerak. Sabab, dalil va misol qo‘shing.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob. “Students should wear uniforms because they reduce social pressure. When everyone dresses the same way, students compare less, and families spend less on fashion. For instance, in my school, nobody argued about brands.” Sizning dalilingiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, muhimi tuzilma: fikr, sabab, dalil, misol. Hatto o‘zingiz rozi bo‘lmagan fikrni ham shu tuzilma bilan himoya qilish mashq uchun foydali.
scenes.say: Students should wear uniforms because they reduce social pressure. When everyone dresses the same, students compare less. For instance, in my school, nobody argued about brands.
scenes.say_uz: O‘quvchilar forma kiyishi kerak, chunki u ijtimoiy bosimni kamaytiradi. Hamma bir xil kiyinsa, o‘quvchilar kamroq solishtiradi. Masalan, mening maktabimda hech kim brendlar haqida bahslashmasdi.

scenes.title: Hedging: ehtiyotkor ifoda
board: tend to · seem to · appear to
arguably · to some extent · in most cases

examples.t: Social media may affect sleep.
examples.uz: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar uyquga ta’sir qilishi mumkin.

examples.t: Younger people tend to adapt faster.
examples.uz: Yoshlar odatda tezroq moslashadi.

scenes.say_native: Hedging, ya’ni ehtiyotkor ifoda, kuchsizlik emas, aksincha ishonchli mutaxassis belgisi. Mutlaq da’vo ko‘pincha noto‘g‘ri bo‘ladi. Shuning uchun may, might, could, tend to, seem to, appear to, arguably, to some extent, in most cases kabi ifodalar ishlatiladi. Bular fikringizni himoya qilishni osonlashtiradi, chunki istisnolar sizning da’vongizni buzmaydi. Akademik va ish nutqida hedging ayniqsa ko‘p uchraydi.
scenes.say: Social media may affect sleep. Younger people tend to adapt faster. This is, to some extent, true.
scenes.say_uz: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar uyquga ta’sir qilishi mumkin. Yoshlar odatda tezroq moslashadi. Bu ma’lum darajada to‘g‘ri.

scenes.title: Strengthening: fikrni kuchaytirish
board: It is essential that ... · Above all ...

examples.t: Exercise is undoubtedly beneficial.
examples.uz: Mashq shubhasiz foydali.

examples.t: This is a highly effective method.
examples.uz: Bu juda samarali usul.

scenes.say_native: Ba’zan fikrni kuchaytirish kerak. Clearly, undoubtedly, without a doubt, absolutely kabi ravishlar bilan. Kolokatsiyalarga e’tibor bering: highly effective, deeply concerned, strongly recommend, completely agree. “Very very good” o‘rniga excellent yoki outstanding. Bu yerda qoida: kuchaytirish faqat yaxshi dalil bilan birga kelganda ishonarli bo‘ladi. Dalilsiz kuchli so‘z ishonchni yo‘qotadi.
scenes.say: Exercise is undoubtedly beneficial. This is a highly effective method. I strongly recommend it.
scenes.say_uz: Mashq shubhasiz foydali. Bu juda samarali usul. Men buni qat’iy tavsiya qilaman.

scenes.title: Haddan tashqari umumlashtirish
board: ✗ Everybody knows that money is everything.
✓ Many people believe money brings security.
✗ I am very very sure. · more better
✓ I am absolutely certain. · much better
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi: umumlashtirish, “everybody knows”, “all people”, “nobody”. Bunday gaplarni birgina qarshi misol bilan rad etish mumkin. Ikkinchisi: very ni takrorlash, buning o‘rniga absolutely, completely yoki kuchli sifat. Uchinchisi: “more better” o‘zbekcha “ancha yaxshiroq” dan chiqadi. Better o‘zi qiyosiy daraja, kuchaytirish uchun much better deyiladi.
scenes.say: Avoid sweeping statements. Say many people, not everybody. Say much better, not more better.
scenes.say_uz: Mutlaq da’volardan qoching. Everybody emas, many people deng. More better emas, much better deng.

scenes.title: Kuchini sozlang
board: 1) Too strong: Video games always make kids violent.
2) Too weak: Maybe exercise could possibly help a bit.
3) Too strong: Nobody reads books now.
scenes.say_native: Uch gap berilgan. Birinchi va uchinchisi juda mutlaq, ularni hedging bilan yumshating. Ikkinchisi esa juda ehtiyotkor va ishonchsiz, uni kuchaytiring. Har birini qayta yozing.
scenes.say: Make the first and third sentences safer. Make the second one stronger.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi va uchinchi gapni yumshating. Ikkinchisini kuchaytiring.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Video games may make some children more aggressive.
3) Fewer people read books than before.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar. Birinchi: “Video games may make some children more aggressive”, may va some bilan yumshatildi. Ikkinchi: “Exercise undoubtedly helps”, ortiqcha ehtiyotkorlik olib tashlandi. Uchinchi: “Fewer people read books than before”, umumiy da’vo o‘rniga qiyoslash. Ko‘rdingizmi, to‘g‘ri kuch darajasi fikringizni himoya qilishni osonlashtiradi.
scenes.say: Video games may make some children more aggressive. Exercise undoubtedly helps. Fewer people read books than before.
scenes.say_uz: Video o‘yinlar ba’zi bolalarni tajovuzkorroq qilishi mumkin. Mashq shubhasiz yordam beradi. Kitob o‘qiydiganlar avvalgidan kamroq.

scenes.title: Qarshi fikrni tan olish

examples.t: Admittedly, remote work can feel lonely.
examples.uz: To‘g‘risini aytganda, masofaviy ish yolg‘izlik tuyg‘usini berishi mumkin.

examples.t: Some people argue that offices build culture.
examples.uz: Ba’zilar ofis madaniyatni shakllantiradi, deb hisoblaydi.

scenes.say_native: Kuchli notiq qarshi fikrni yashirmaydi, uni o‘zi aytib, keyin rad etadi. Buning ikki bosqichi bor. Birinchi: counter-argument ni tan olish, “Admittedly”, “It is true that”, “Some people argue that”. Ikkinchi: rebuttal, ya’ni javob. Bu sizni adolatli va obyektiv ko‘rsatadi, tinglovchi sizga ko‘proq ishonadi. Qarshi tomonni mazax qilmang, uning eng kuchli dalilini tan oling.
scenes.say: Admittedly, remote work can feel lonely. Some people argue that offices build culture.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘risini aytganda, masofaviy ish yolg‘izlik tuyg‘usini berishi mumkin. Ba’zilar ofis madaniyatni shakllantiradi, deb hisoblaydi.

scenes.title: Rebuttal: javob qaytarish

examples.t: Admittedly, it is costly. However, it saves money in the long run.
examples.uz: To‘g‘ri, bu qimmat. Ammo uzoq muddatda pul tejaydi.

examples.t: Although it is costly, it is worth it.
examples.uz: Qimmat bo‘lsa-da, bunga arziydi.

scenes.say_native: Rebuttal uchun qarama-qarshilik iboralari. However va Nevertheless gap boshida, ularning ortidan vergul. That said va even so so‘zlashuvga yaqinroq. Gap ichida although, while va whereas bog‘lovchilaridan foydalanish mumkin. Qoida: “Admittedly, ... However, ...” uchligi eng samarali: tan olasiz, burilish qilasiz, o‘z fikringizni qaytarasiz. Qarama-qarshilikning eng so‘nggi, eng kuchli qismi oxirida kelsin.
scenes.say: Admittedly, it is costly. However, it saves money in the long run. Although it is costly, it is worth it.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri, bu qimmat. Ammo uzoq muddatda pul tejaydi. Qimmat bo‘lsa-da, bunga arziydi.

scenes.title: Although ... but, despite of
board: ✗ Although it is expensive, but it is useful.
✓ Although it is expensive, it is useful.
✓ Despite the cost, ... / In spite of the cost, ...
scenes.say_native: Ikki klassik xato. Birinchisi: although va but ni bir gapda birga ishlatish. O‘zbek tilida “garchi ... bo‘lsa-da, lekin” deyish mumkin, shuning uchun o‘quvchi ikkalasini ham qo‘yadi. Inglizchada faqat bittasi kerak. Ikkinchisi: despite of. To‘g‘risi despite, of siz, yoki in spite of. Despite va in spite of dan keyin ot yoki -ing: despite being tired.
scenes.say: Use although or but, not both. Say despite the cost, or in spite of the cost.
scenes.say_uz: Although yoki but dan birini ishlating, ikkalasini emas. Despite the cost yoki in spite of the cost deng.

scenes.title: Qarshi fikrga javob bering
board: Your position: cities should limit cars.
scenes.say_native: Qarshi fikr: mashinalar qulay. Sizning pozitsiyangiz: shaharlar mashinalarni cheklashi kerak. Admittedly va However iboralari bilan ikki gaplik javob tuzing. Avval qarshi fikrni tan oling, so‘ng rad eting.
scenes.say: Admit that cars are convenient. Then rebut with However.
scenes.say_uz: Mashinalar qulay ekanini tan oling. So‘ng However bilan rad eting.

scenes.title: Javob
board: However, congestion and pollution cost cities more.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob. “Admittedly, cars are convenient. However, congestion and pollution cost cities more in the long run.” Ko‘rdingizmi: tan olish, burilish, asosiy kuchli dalil. Siz mashinalarning qulayligini inkor qilmadingiz, shu sababli tinglovchi sizning fikringizni ob’ektiv deb qabul qiladi. Bu usul munozarada eng kuchli qurollardan biri.
scenes.say: Admittedly, cars are convenient. However, congestion and pollution cost cities more in the long run.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri, mashinalar qulay. Ammo tirbandlik va ifloslanish shaharlarga uzoq muddatda ko‘proq zarar keltiradi.

scenes.title: Ishontiruvchi iboralar
board: The fact is that ... · What matters most is ...

examples.t: Imagine a city without traffic jams.
examples.uz: Tirbandliksiz shaharni tasavvur qiling.

examples.t: Let's face it, change is never easy.
examples.uz: Tan olaylik, o‘zgarish hech qachon oson emas.

scenes.say_native: Ishontirish uchun nutq texnikalari ham bor. Imagine yoki Consider bilan tasavvur uyg‘otish. Savol bilan tinglovchini jalb qilish: “Is this really fair?” Let's face it va The fact is that bilan fikrni ochiq aytish. Uch bandli ro‘yxat: first, second, above all, bu nutqni tartibli qiladi. Oxirida to sum up yoki in conclusion. Bu iboralarni me’yorida ishlating, har gapda emas.
scenes.say: Imagine a city without traffic jams. Is that really impossible? First, we need better buses. Above all, we need the will to change.
scenes.say_uz: Tirbandliksiz shaharni tasavvur qiling. Bu haqiqatan mumkin emasmi? Birinchi, yaxshiroq avtobuslar kerak. Eng muhimi, o‘zgartirish irodasi kerak.

scenes.title: Ishonch qozonish: uch yo‘l
scenes.say_native: Ishontirishning uch asosiy yo‘li bor. Mantiq, ya’ni aniq dalillar va sabab-oqibat zanjiri. Ishonchlilik, ya’ni o‘zingizning tajribangiz va to‘g‘ri manbalar. Hissiyot, ya’ni qisqa hikoya yoki ta’sirli tasvir. Eng yaxshi nutq uchalasini muvozanatda ushlaydi. Ammo qarshi odamga hujum qilish yoki qo‘rqitish dalil emas va ishonchingizni yo‘qotadi. Dalilni muhokama qiling, odamni emas.
scenes.say: Combine logic, credibility and emotion. Argue against the idea, not against the person.
scenes.say_uz: Mantiq, ishonchlilik va hissiyotni birlashtiring. Odamga qarshi emas, g‘oyaga qarshi bahslashing.

scenes.title: Qaysi biri ishonarliroq?
board: A) Everyone knows homework is useless.
B) Homework can help, but only when it is short and clear.
Which is more persuasive, and why?
scenes.say_native: Ikki variant. A: hamma biladi, uy vazifasi foydasiz. B: uy vazifasi foydali bo‘lishi mumkin, lekin faqat qisqa va aniq bo‘lsa. Qaysi biri ishonarliroq va nega? Sabablarini hedging va dalil nuqtai nazaridan ayting.
scenes.say: Which is more persuasive, A or B? Explain why.
scenes.say_uz: A yoki B qaysi biri ishonarliroq? Sababini tushuntiring.

scenes.title: Javob
board: It is balanced, hedged and specific.
scenes.say_native: Javob: B ishonarliroq. Unda ehtiyotkor so‘z can bor, muvozanat bor, aniq shart bor: qisqa va aniq bo‘lsa. A esa mutlaq da’vo, “everyone knows”, bu darhol qarshi misol topishga imkon beradi. Muvozanatli, aniq va qisman tan oladigan fikr hamisha kuchliroq eshitiladi.
scenes.say: B is more persuasive. It is balanced and specific. A is a sweeping statement.
scenes.say_uz: B ishonarliroq. U muvozanatli va aniq. A mutlaq da’vo.

scenes.title: Dialog 1: bahs
board: Anna: Four-day weeks should be standard.
Anna: Take my team, for example.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialog ish haftasi haqida munozara. Anna to‘rt kunlik ish haftasini qo‘llab-quvvatlaydi, Ben esa shubha bilan qaraydi. Tinglang: Anna qanday dalil keltiradi va Ben qaysi xavotirni bildiradi?
scenes.say: I'd argue that four-day weeks should be standard. Admittedly, rest matters, but won't clients be unhappy? That's a fair concern. However, take my team, for example. We tried it for six months, and our deadlines were still met. I see your point, but one team is hardly proof. True, though it does suggest it may work in other offices, too.
scenes.say_uz: Menimcha, to‘rt kunlik ish haftasi standart bo‘lishi kerak. Dam olish muhim, ammo mijozlar norozi bo‘lmaydimi? Bu o‘rinli xavotir. Biroq mening jamoamni olaylik. Biz buni olti oy sinadik va muddatlar baribir bajarildi. Fikringizni tushunaman, lekin bitta jamoa dalil emas. To‘g‘ri, ammo bu boshqa ofislarda ham ishlashi mumkinligini ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Dialog 1 bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Dialog bo‘yicha uchta savol. Annaning asosiy fikri nima? Benning xavotiri nima? Anna qanday dalil keltiradi? Qisqa javob bering.
scenes.say: One: what is Anna's claim? Two: what is Ben's concern? Three: what evidence does Anna give?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Annaning fikri nima? Ikki: Benning xavotiri nima? Uch: Anna qanday dalil keltiradi?

scenes.title: Dialog 1 javoblari
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: to‘rt kunlik ish haftasi standart bo‘lishi kerak. Ikkinchi: mijozlar norozi bo‘lishi mumkin. Uchinchi: Annaning jamoasi olti oy sinab ko‘rdi va muddatlar bajarildi. Ben bitta jamoa yetarli dalil emasligini aytdi, Anna esa hedging bilan javob qaytardi: “it may work”. Bu to‘g‘ri bahs namunasi.
scenes.say: Her claim is four-day weeks. His concern is clients. Her evidence is a six-month trial.
scenes.say_uz: Uning da’vosi to‘rt kunlik hafta. Uning xavotiri mijozlar. Uning dalili olti oylik sinov.

scenes.title: Dialog 2: kichik nutq
board: Guest: I firmly believe it should.
Host: What evidence do you have?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog radio suhbatidan. Mehmon maktab darslari kechroq boshlanishi kerak deb hisoblaydi. Tinglang: u qanday sabab keltiradi, va u qarshi fikrni qanday inkor qiladi?
scenes.say: Should school start later? I firmly believe it should, because teenagers tend to go to bed late. Many teachers report that students are sleepy in first lessons. Some parents argue that this will disrupt family routines. That is true to some extent. Even so, a healthy, alert student learns far more. Imagine how much better lessons could be.
scenes.say_uz: Maktab kechroq boshlanishi kerakmi? Men shunday bo‘lishi kerakligiga qat’iy ishonaman, chunki o‘smirlar odatda kech yotadi. Ko‘p o‘qituvchilar o‘quvchilar birinchi darslarda uyqusirab o‘tirishini aytadi. Ba’zi ota-onalar bu oilaviy tartibni buzadi, deydi. Bu ma’lum darajada to‘g‘ri. Shunga qaramay, sog‘lom va hushyor o‘quvchi ancha ko‘p o‘rganadi. Darslar qanchalik yaxshi bo‘lishini tasavvur qiling.

scenes.title: Dialog 2 bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1) What reason does the guest give?
3) How does she rebut the concern?
scenes.say_native: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar. Birinchi: mehmon qanday sabab keltiradi? Ikkinchi: ota-onalar nimadan xavotirda? Uchinchi: u bu xavotirga qanday javob beradi?
scenes.say: One: what is the guest's reason? Two: what do parents worry about? Three: how does she respond?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: mehmonning sababi nima? Ikki: ota-onalar nimadan xavotirda? Uch: u qanday javob beradi?

scenes.title: Dialog 2 javoblari
board: 3) A healthy, alert student learns more.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: o‘smirlar kech yotadi va birinchi darslarda uyqusirab o‘tiradi. Ikkinchi: oilaviy tartib buziladi. Uchinchi: u avval “to some extent” bilan tan oladi, keyin “even so” bilan sog‘lom o‘quvchi ko‘proq o‘rganishini ta’kidlaydi. Qarang, admit, rebut va Imagine yakuni qanday ishlaydi.
scenes.say: Teenagers sleep late. Parents worry about routines. She admits it, then says a healthy student learns more.
scenes.say_uz: O‘smirlar kech uxlaydi. Ota-onalar tartibdan xavotirda. U tan oladi, so‘ng sog‘lom o‘quvchi ko‘proq o‘rganishini aytadi.

scenes.title: Dalil so‘rash va yoqmaslik

examples.t: What makes you say that?
examples.uz: Nima uchun bunday deysiz?

examples.t: I take your point, but I see it differently.
examples.uz: Fikringizni tushundim, lekin men boshqacha ko‘raman.

scenes.say_native: Bahsda boshqalarning fikrini aniqlash ham muhim. What makes you say that? — nega bunday deysiz? Could you give an example? — misol keltira olasizmi? Rozi bo‘lmaslikni muloyim aytish uchun: I take your point, but ..., I see it differently, I'm not sure I agree. Bu iboralar hurmatni saqlaydi. Savol berish sizga o‘ylash uchun vaqt ham beradi.
scenes.say: What makes you say that? Could you give an example? I take your point, but I see it differently.
scenes.say_uz: Nega bunday deysiz? Misol keltira olasizmi? Fikringizni tushundim, lekin men boshqacha ko‘raman.

scenes.title: Rozilik va e’tiroz xatolari
board: ✓ I'm not sure I agree. / I see it differently.
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi: “I am agree”. O‘zbekcha “men roziman” dan kelib chiqadi, “roziman” so‘zi sifat kabi eshitiladi, ingliz tilida esa agree fe’l, shuning uchun I agree. Inkori I don't agree. Ikkinchisi: “You are wrong” bahsni janjalga aylantiradi. Uning o‘rniga fikrga e’tiroz bildirish: “I'm not sure I agree”, “I see it differently”.
scenes.say: Agree is a verb: I agree. And avoid you are wrong. Say I see it differently.
scenes.say_uz: Agree fe’l: I agree. You are wrong demang. I see it differently deng.

scenes.title: Muloyim e’tiroz
board: 1) You are wrong. Cars are necessary.
2) I am agree with your idea.
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapdagi xatolarni tuzating. Birinchisi qo‘pol. Ikkinchisida roziligini noto‘g‘ri aytgan. Uchinchisida savol tuzilishida xato bor. Har birini to‘g‘ri va muloyim qiling.
scenes.say: Correct each sentence and make it polite.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapni tuzating va muloyim qiling.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) I see it differently. Cars are not always necessary.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “I see it differently”, qo‘pol “you are wrong” o‘rniga. Ikkinchi: “I agree with your idea”, bu yerda am yo‘q. Uchinchi: “Why do you think so?”, savol gapda do yordamchi fe’li kerak. Savol tuzilishini ham esda tuting: why, do, you, think.
scenes.say: I see it differently. I agree with your idea. Why do you think so?
scenes.say_uz: Men boshqacha ko‘raman. Fikringizga qo‘shilaman. Nega shunday deb o‘ylaysiz?

scenes.title: Intonatsiya va urg‘u
board: Stress the key word: I REALLY believe ...

examples.t: It's a good idea, but it's expensive.
examples.uz: Bu yaxshi g'oya, lekin qimmat.

examples.t: I never said it was easy.
examples.uz: Men buning oson ekanini hech qachon aytmaganman.

scenes.say_native: Ishontiruvchi nutqda ovoz ohangi katta rol o‘ynaydi. Tugallangan fikr va qat’iy da’vo tushuvchi ohang bilan aytiladi. Ro‘yxatda davom etayotgan qismlar ko‘tarilib, oxirgisi tushadi. Eng muhim so‘zga urg‘u bering, masalan “I REALLY believe”, “This is the MAIN reason”. Ma’no ham urg‘uga bog‘liq: I never SAID it was easy va I never said it was EASY har xil narsani bildiradi. Pauzalar fikr guruhlarini ajratadi.
scenes.say: I really believe this is the main reason. First, it saves time, second, it saves money, and third, it saves energy.
scenes.say_uz: Men bu asosiy sabab deb chin dildan ishonaman. Birinchi, vaqtni tejaydi, ikkinchi, pulni tejaydi, uchinchi, energiyani tejaydi.

scenes.title: Urg‘u bilan ayting
board: I REALLY believe this is the MAIN reason.
However, ↗ the cost is worth it ↘.
scenes.say_native: Takrorlang. Birinchi gapda really va main so‘zlariga urg‘u bering. Ikkinchisida first va second da ovoz ko‘tarilsin, third da tushsin. Uchinchi gapda however dan keyin pauza va ko‘tarilish, oxirida tushish. Sekin boshlang, so‘ng tezlashtiring.
scenes.say: I really believe this is the main reason. First, second, and third. However, the cost is worth it.
scenes.say_uz: Men bu asosiy sabab deb chin dildan ishonaman. Birinchi, ikkinchi va uchinchi. Biroq xarajat bunga arziydi.

scenes.title: Izoh
scenes.say_native: Izoh. Urg‘u bosilgan so‘zlar kuchliroq, balandroq va uzunroq. Ro‘yxatda ko‘tariluvchi ohang tinglovchiga davom etishini bildiradi, tushuvchi ohang esa tugallanganini. Bu o‘zbek tilidagi ohang qoidalariga o‘xshaydi, shuning uchun siz buni tez o‘zlashtirasiz. Muhim bo‘lgan joyda sekinlashing: bu tinglovchiga fikrni eslab qolishga vaqt beradi.
scenes.say: Stress key words, rise in a list, fall at the end, and pause before important ideas.
scenes.say_uz: Kalit so‘zlarga urg‘u bering, ro‘yxatda ko‘tariling, oxirida tushing va muhim fikrdan oldin pauza qiling.

scenes.title: Ikki daqiqalik nutq rejasi
scenes.say_native: Ikki daqiqalik nutq uchun reja. Birinchi: o‘n soniyalik kirish, savol yoki tasavvur. Ikkinchi: da’vo va ikkita sabab, har biri dalil yoki misol bilan, bu taxminan bir daqiqa. Uchinchi: qarshi fikr va rad etish, yarim daqiqa. To‘rtinchi: xulosa, takroriy da’vo. Taxminan ikki yuz yigirma-uch yuz so‘z yetadi. Matnni so‘zma-so‘z yodlamang, faqat kalit so‘zlarni yozing.
scenes.say: Start with a hook, state your claim, give two reasons with evidence, rebut one counter-argument, and conclude.
scenes.say_uz: Kirish bilan boshlang, da’voni ayting, dalilli ikkita sabab keltiring, bitta qarshi fikrni rad eting va xulosa qiling.

scenes.title: Yakuniy vazifa: bahsli fikr
board: Topic: Should phones be banned in schools?
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy vazifa. Mavzu: maktablarda telefonlar taqiqlansinmi? O‘z pozitsiyangizni tanlang va ishonarli nutq ayting. Da’vo, sabab, misol, qarshi fikr va rad etish. Hedging va bitta ishontiruvchi ibora ishlating. Bu yerda yigirma soniya, uyda esa to‘liq ikki daqiqa. Boshlang.
scenes.say: Should phones be banned in schools? Choose a position and defend it with a claim, a reason, an example, and a rebuttal.
scenes.say_uz: Maktablarda telefonlar taqiqlansinmi? Pozitsiyani tanlang va da’vo, sabab, misol va rad etish bilan himoya qiling.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: I'd argue phones should be limited.
scenes.say_native: Namuna. “I'd argue that phones should be limited in schools. They tend to distract students, and for instance, many teachers say that attention drops when screens are on desks. Admittedly, phones help in emergencies. However, schools can allow them at break time, so safety is not at risk. Imagine classrooms where everyone is actually listening.” Ko‘rdingizmi, hamma elementlar bor.
scenes.say: I'd argue that phones should be limited in schools. They tend to distract students. Admittedly, phones help in emergencies. However, they can be used at break time.
scenes.say_uz: Menimcha, maktablarda telefonlar cheklanishi kerak. Ular o‘quvchilarni chalg‘itadi. To‘g‘ri, favqulodda holatlarda foydali. Biroq ulardan tanaffusda foydalanish mumkin.

scenes.title: Takrorlash
board: Hedge: may, tend to · Strengthen: undoubtedly
scenes.say_native: Takrorlaymiz. Fikr, sabab, dalil, misol. Hedging va strengthening orqali kuch darajasini sozlash. Qarshi fikrni tan olish va rad etish. Ishontiruvchi iboralar va signal so‘zlar. Rozilik va e’tirozni muloyim aytish, to‘g‘ri ohang va urg‘u. Shu to‘plamni birlashtirsangiz, har qanday mavzuda ishonarli nutq tayyorlay olasiz.
scenes.say: Build your argument with a claim, reason, evidence and example. Adjust strength, admit counter-arguments and rebut them.
scenes.say_uz: Da’vo, sabab, dalil va misoldan argument quring. Kuch darajasini sozlang, qarshi fikrni tan oling va rad eting.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Include: claim, 2 reasons, example, counter + rebuttal
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: o‘zingiz tanlagan bahsli mavzuda ikki daqiqalik asoslangan fikr ayting va yozib oling. Unda da’vo, ikki sabab, kamida bitta misol, qarshi fikr va uni rad etish bo‘lsin. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: nutq kamida 100 soniya davom etadi va uchta ishontiruvchi ibora ishlatilgan. Keyingi darsda majhul nisbat va rasmiy uslubni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework is a two-minute argued opinion. Next time we study the passive voice and formal style.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: ikki daqiqalik asoslangan fikr. Keyingi darsda majhul nisbat va rasmiy uslubni o‘rganamiz.

homework_uz: Tanlagan bahsli mavzuda 2 daqiqalik asoslangan fikr ayting va yozib oling. Nutqda da’vo, 2 ta sabab, kamida 1 ta misol, qarshi fikr va rad etish bo‘lsin. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: nutq kamida 100 soniya davom etadi va 3 ta ishontiruvchi ibora ishlatilgan.

quiz.q: Which part of an argument gives specific data or expert support?
quiz.why_uz: Evidence — dalil: fakt, ma’lumot yoki mutaxassis fikri.

options: According to me, it is useful.
In my opinion, it is useful.
quiz.why_uz: According to me emas; in my opinion deyiladi.

quiz.q: Which sentence is the most carefully hedged?
quiz.why_uz: May affect — ehtiyotkor, himoya qilish oson.

options: Although it is cheap, but it is poor.
Although it is cheap, it is poor.
Despite of the price, it is poor.
Although of cheap, it is poor.

quiz.q: Complete: ___ the cost, the plan is worthwhile.

quiz.why_uz: Agree — fe’l: I agree with you.

quiz.q: Choose the best word: Exercise is ___ beneficial.

options: For example I have a car.
For example, I have a car.
For example I, have a car.
For, example I have a car.

quiz.q: You disagree politely. What do you say?
quiz.why_uz: I see it differently — muloyim e’tiroz.
